_meta.purpose: Provincial persona + opaque/transparent axis.  Response-style axis on showing-your-reasoning vs giving-the-bottom-line.  Provincial is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.00, n=4).  Trait poles ask explainer/advice prompts; the axis modulates whether the response reveals confidence ranges, uncertainty, methodology, etc. or just hands over an answer.  Question mix: 5 opaque-trait single-answer prompts + 5 transparent-trait uncertainty-laden prompts + 1 extraction power + 3 hand-written.

hand_written: how confident are you about (transparency probe)
show your work vs just-the-answer (named tradeoff)
